name: BESCOM Gruha Jyothi Tenant Registration — Electricity Subsidy Pre-Audit
governing_act: Karnataka Gruha Jyothi Scheme G.O. No. DE 48 EEB 2023 dated 01-Jul-2023
required_documents: Latest BESCOM Electricity Bill (original — not older than 2 billing cycles)
Proof of residence / Rental Agreement (if tenant — registered or Notarised)
Property owner's consent letter with owner's Aadhaar (for tenant applications)
Ration Card (if availing LPG/Ration subsidy — to verify no double subsidy)

validation_rules.message: Monthly electricity consumption exceeds the Gruha Jyothi scheme ceiling of 200 units. Consumers exceeding 200 units in any single billing cycle are automatically ineligible for that month's subsidy.
validation_rules.remediation: 1. Apply for a meter verification/calibration check at the nearest BESCOM subdivision office. 2. If consumption is genuine, the household is ineligible under Gruha Jyothi for this cycle.
validation_rules.reference: Gruha Jyothi Scheme G.O. Clause 4(ii), BESCOM Implementation Circular dated 15-Jul-2023

validation_rules.message: BESCOM RR Number (Account Number) contains alphabetic characters. Gruha Jyothi subsidy linkage to DBT requires a purely numeric 10-digit BESCOM Account Number.
validation_rules.remediation: 1. Visit the BESCOM Consumer Service Portal (bescom.karnataka.gov.in) and use 'Know Your Consumer Number' to retrieve the 10-digit numeric account number. 2. If the account was recently created, visit the nearest BESCOM Sub-Division office.
validation_rules.reference: BESCOM Consumer Services Circular No. BESCOM/CS/2022/107 dated 10-Nov-2022

validation_rules.message: Applicant name on the Gruha Jyothi form does not match the name on the BESCOM bill/account. Subsidy disbursement via DBT requires name-on-bill to match the Aadhaar-linked name in the BESCOM consumer database.
validation_rules.remediation: 1. File a 'Consumer Name Correction' application at BESCOM Sub-Division office (Form BESCOM-NC-02) with Aadhaar and bill. 2. If applicant is a tenant, submit Rental Agreement + owner consent letter.

validation_rules.message: Applicant name differs from BESCOM bill account holder name. This indicates the applicant may be a tenant applying on the property owner's connection. A registered Rental/Lease Agreement and Property Owner's Consent are mandatory.
validation_rules.remediation: Attach: (1) Registered Rental/Lease Agreement OR Notarised Rental Agreement. (2) Property owner's consent letter signed by owner + owner's Aadhaar copy.
validation_rules.reference: Gruha Jyothi Scheme G.O. Clause 6(c) — Tenant Eligibility Criteria

validation_rules.message: Application submission date + 7 Sakala working days has elapsed without disposal. Gruha Jyothi registration falls under Schedule-I of Karnataka Sakala Services Act 2011.
validation_rules.remediation: File a Sakala SLA breach complaint at sakala.kar.nic.in with your GSC acknowledgement number.
validation_rules.reference: Karnataka Sakala Services Act 2011 — Schedule I, Serial No. 48 (BESCOM Services)

To,
The Sub-Division Engineer / Subdivision Manager,
BESCOM [SUBDIVISION_NAME] Subdivision,
Bengaluru — [PINCODE]

Date: [DATE]

Sub: Application for Gruha Jyothi Tenant Registration for BESCOM Account No. [ACCOUNT_NUMBER]

Respected Sir/Madam,

I, [APPLICANT_NAME], Aadhaar No. XXXX XXXX [AADHAAR_LAST4], am a tenant residing at [PROPERTY_ADDRESS], Ward: [WARD_NAME], Bengaluru — [PINCODE].

The BESCOM electricity connection at the above address (Account No. [ACCOUNT_NUMBER]) stands in the name of the property owner, Shri/Smt. [OWNER_NAME].

I wish to register myself as a beneficiary under the Gruha Jyothi scheme for the said connection.

Enclosures:
1. Registered Rental Agreement dated [RENTAL_DATE]
2. Property Owner's Consent Letter (signed by [OWNER_NAME])
3. Aadhaar Card (self-attested)
4. Latest BESCOM Bill

Yours faithfully,
[APPLICANT_NAME]
Mobile: [MOBILE_NUMBER]
